etymologies.etymologyHTML: From Middle English houswyf, housewif, huswijf, equivalent to house +‎ wife; a doublet of hussy, which it was long-distinguished with and displaced due to gradual negative connotation (see Online Etymology Dictionary entry). Cognate with German Hausweib.

definitions.definition: (plural "housewives") A woman whose main employment is homemaking, maintaining the upkeep of her home and tending to household affairs; often, such a woman whose sole [unpaid] employment is homemaking.

quote.citation: 2000, Uli Kusch, "Mr. Torture", Helloween, The Dark Ride
quote.text: Mr Torture sells pain / To the housewives in Spain / He knows just what they crave / Mr Torture

definitions.definition: (plural "housewives") The wife of a householder; the mistress of a family; the female head of a household.
(plural "housewifes") A little case or bag for materials used in sewing, and for other articles of female work.

quote.citation: 1828, JT Smith, Nollekens and His Times, Century Hutchinson, published 1986, page 246:
quote.text: It was a housewife, containing needles, a bodkin, and thread; ‘and, do you know,’ added he, ‘it was the most useful thing she could have given me, for it lasted all the time I was at Rome to mend my clothes with  […] .’

quote.citation: 1852, Tom Taylor, Charles Reade, Masks and Faces, act II:
quote.text: Woffington's housewife, made by herself, homely to the eye, but holds everything in the world

quote.citation: 1997, David L. Phillips, A Soldier's Story, MetroBooks, →ISBN, page 61:
quote.text: The "soldier's housewife" was a small sewing kit that was carried to make timely repairs to clothing and equipment.

definitions.definition: (plural "housewives", obsolete) A worthless woman; a hussy.

quote.citation: 1983 December 10, Jolanta Benal, “The Second Revolution”, in Gay Community News, volume 11, number 21, page 14:
quote.text: Career opportunity  […]  is the one who never knocks — especially not on the doors of women, who are still hooking, housewifing and hairdressing for their livings.
